name: ofp_probe
title: OP FREAK measurement overlay (probe)
status_note: built and host-tested only; never run on a device
summary: Full-screen measurement overlay, off by default, toggled by shift + speech: CPU % (idle thread, now + peak), audio ISR busy % and per-block worst case, late / hot block counters, USB to-host ring fill / underrun / overrun / drift, TLSF + VDK heap free, flash free, tape yaffs write stalls. Also shows the raw volume-knob byte and the accelerometer words.

pointers.what: kTE_Idle vtable run slot: remember the idle thread (VDK run-cycle statistics)

call_sites.what: tape_c::service: lseek before the clip write (start stamp)
tape_c::service: yaffs_write of a dirty clip returned (end stamp)

controls: shift + speech: off -> page 1 -> page 2 -> off (opening resets counters)
